newsitem.title: USA: May Brent extends losses in late US paper trading.
newsitem.headline: May Brent extends losses in late US paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil tumbled in late U.S. paper trading on Wednesday, extending the day's already sharp technically driven losses, traders said.
A top Wall Street firm sold a full boat of May paper Brent at $18.25 a barrel, down 25 cents from the settlement of $18.50 on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE).
A series of partial May Brent cargoes changed hands at $18.10, $18.12 and $18.15 a barrel.
Two May/June Brents traded at minus 24 cents a barrel, down four cents from the day's earlier deals.
